items: Create and manage group events with timezone-aware schedules and all-day options.
Browse upcoming events in a timeline or month calendar, with controls for creating, editing, and relaying events.
Share events with other groups when permitted, with clear provenance and relay controls.
Subscribe to secure iCalendar feeds for a single group or all your events. Draft events are excluded, and feeds are ordered by start time.
See your detected timezone in your profile and access group events directly from the group menu.
Calendar dialogs and form feedback now provide a cleaner, more focused experience.
